Letter of offer for right shares
Notice is hereby given to the members of Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited ("Company")
that the Company intends to increase the paid-up capital of the Company by issuing
99,802,556/­right shares to the members in their existing proportion, subject to increase of
authorised share capital. The right offer must be accepted or declined on or before 18 June
2019. In case of no reply, it is considered that the member is declining the offer. The details
are as under:
